title: Online Recruitment System
desc: Web platform to automate the hiring lifecycle: job posting → screening → scheduling → offer. Role-based dashboards, resume filtering, secure auth, admin-user profile management, and responsive UI.

title: Smart Packing System
desc: I designed and implemented a Smart Parking System using the C programming language to efficiently manage parking spaces using real-time sensor data. The system detects and displays available parking spots, helping reduce traffic congestion and optimize space utilization within parking facilities.
